candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500 (db, payment, inventory) is not established; logs excluded and no dependency metrics returned.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order service 500s on /v1/orders; gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Underlying order fault not yet localized.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors explaining the 500 on /v1/orders
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to localize the 500
